texts.preamble: Royal Choice And Restaurant vs District Hospital on 22 February, 2017 Author: P.B.Suresh Kumar Bench: P.B.Suresh Kumar In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present: The Honourable Mr. Justice P.B.Suresh Kumar Wednesday, The 21St Day Of June 2017/31St Jyaishta, 1939 WP(C).No. 18297 of 2017 (J) ---------------------------- Petitioner : ------------- Royal Choice And Restaurant Old Lakkady Road, P.O Akalur, Ottappalam, Represented By Its Proprietor, Shri K.E Safwan, Residing At Kunnappally (H) Old By Adv. Dr.George Abraham Respondents : ----------- 1. District Hospital, Palakkad Pin 678 001, Represented By Its Superintendent. 2. The Superintendent, District Hospital, Palakkad - 678 001. 3. The Secretary, District Panchayath, Palakkad. 4. R. Gangadharan, Perumbarathulla, Kozhinjanpara P.O, Palakkad Pin - 678 555. R1 & R2 By Government Pleader Smt K.R. Deepa R3 By Sri.P.K.Nijoy Royal Choice And Restaurant vs District Hospital on 22 February, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26591932/ 1 This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Been Finally Heard On 21-06-2017, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: bp WP(C).No. 18297 of 2017 (J) ---------------------------- Appendix Petitioner(S)' Exhibits ----------------------- Exhibit P1: True Copy Of The Tender Form Dated 22.02.2017 Issued By The Superintendent, District Hospital Palakkad. Exhibit P2: True Copy Of The Tender Submission And Confirmation Dated 31.03.2017 Exhibit P3: True Copy Of Form - C Dated 01.04.2012 Issued By The Food Safety And Standards Authority Of India Issued To The Petitioner. Exhibit P4: True Copy Of The Petition Filed By The Petitioner On 21.04.2017 Before The Public Information Officer Under Rti Act.
texts.facts: The petitioner participated in the tender process commenced as per Ext.P1 notice for the conduct of a canteen attached to the District Hospital, Palakkad. The fourth respondent was running the canteen in the previous year. The case of the petitioner is that without finalising the tender process, the fourth respondent, whose tender was found to be defective, is permitted to run the canteen indefinitely.
